---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure
---

## Reproduce

Include the command, minimal config, dataset format/scene and repository revision.
Use a small fixture where possible; do not attach private data or large weights.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include the relevant error or traceback.

## Environment

Include OS, Python, PyTorch build, selected device and compile setting. For CUDA,
include GPU model and driver version. Mention changes from the locked environment.
